00254 #define EVENT_MIXFILLFUNCTION_DOCS                  You must implement this virtual function in your subclass.                      \
00255                                                     The parent MixFill UGen calls this function multiple times to                   \
00256                                                     create an array of UGen instances to mix.                                       \
00257                                                     @param eventCount   The index of the event instance starting at 0 for           \
00258                                                                         the first event.                                            \
00259                                                     @return             The UGen graph for this event instance.

00265 class MixFillBaseEventBase
00266 {
00267 public:
00268     PREDOC(EVENT_MIXFILLFUNCTION_DOCS)
00269     virtual UGen createEvent(const int eventCount) = 0;
00270     
00275     UGenArray createArray(const int size)
00276     {
00277         UGenArray array;
00278         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00279             array <<= createEvent(i);
00280         return array;
00281     }
00282 };
